change.summary: Layer-driven action references and JavaFX menu presentation.
change.description: Adds FxActionRef, ActionLayerReader and LayerMenuBuilder, so menus can be assembled from the action references the nbfx annotations write under NbFx/Menus, NbFx/Toolbars and NbFx/ContextMenus instead of hard-coded id lists. The API is under development until the MVP freeze.

ViewProvider now extends Lookup.Provider and adds a default getLookup() returning Lookup.EMPTY, so the active view's lookup can be published as the global action context (the nbfx replacement for the activated TopComponent's lookup). Existing implementations are unaffected; the default is empty.

EditorDocument now extends Lookup.Provider and adds a default getLookup() carrying the document and its file, so the active editor's lookup can be published as the global action context (the nbfx replacement for the editor TopComponent's lookup). Existing implementations are unaffected.

change.summary: FileSelectionContext keeps only the navigator focus signal.
change.description: Removes FileSelectionContext.selectedFiles() and setSelectedFiles(List). The navigator selection is now published by each navigator through its own ViewProvider.getLookup(), since the global action context follows the active component; only the navigator-focused signal, which is shell state rather than selection, remains. Under development until the MVP freeze.

change.summary: NavigatorProvider removed; navigator concerns on ViewProvider.
change.description: Removes NavigatorProvider. The project views are now plain ViewProviders (marked as navigators by their view registration) and observe ProjectRegistry instead of being fed. The shell-facing navigator concerns move to ViewProvider defaults (revealFile, restoreExpandedPaths/restoreSelectedPath, getExpandedPaths/getSelectedPath, setOnProjectLoaded/setOnProjectLoadFailed, selectedFile); project-type icons and file reveal become the targeted services ProjectIconProvider and NavigatorRevealer. Under development until the MVP freeze.

change.summary: Editor hyperlinks, gutter annotations and element context menus for Java navigation.
change.description: Adds the SPIs the Java structure module (nbfx.structure.java) implements for the editor: HyperlinkProvider (Shortcut+Click goes to the declaration, Alt+Shortcut+Click to the implementations), EditorAnnotationProvider with EditorAnnotation (the gutter glyphs of overriding and overridden methods), ElementContextMenuContributor (items for a source element shown outside the editor, such as a row of the Navigator) and SourceLocation; the Navigate command ids in ActionIds; EditorDocument.textVersionProperty() and getCaretScreenPosition(); Command.getIcon() for a command that brings its own icon to the menus the shell builds; and CellBreadth, the shared cell width that keeps a tree's horizontal scroll bar from oscillating. Under development until the MVP freeze.

change.summary: ActiveComponentContext replaces ViewSelectionContext; editors are active components.
change.description: Adds ActiveComponent (a sealed Lookup.Provider with ViewComponent and EditorComponent) and ActiveComponentContext, the active component of the focused pane - a tool view or an editor. The global action context follows it, so selecting an editor makes the context carry that editor's document instead of leaving it on the previously active view. Removes ViewSelectionContext, which only ever carried a ViewProvider and left editors to a separate document property. Under development until the MVP freeze.

head.title: Change History for the NetBeansFX API

body.p: This document lists changes made to the NetBeansFX API.
